rejected_rule.statement: A person must have undisturbed and uninterrupted possession of land for a period of ten years to succeed in a prescriptive claim.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: Therefore, the defendant should have established that he was in possession of the land adverse to the rights of the others who claim rights to the land at least for a period of ten years from 20.7.1982 for him to have prescriptive rights to this land.
